summary.text: Anil Beephan Jr., also known as AJ, is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 105 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; before joining the Assembly he held legislative staff roles and served on the East Fishkill town council.

paragraphs.text: Beephan lives in East Fishkill, New York, and earned a B.A. in political science from Arcadia University in 2016 and a master of liberal arts in management from Harvard University in 2019.
His career experience includes working in various legislative roles for state Sen. Susan J. Serino and as a public relations and marketing strategist.
Beephan was also a council member in the Town of East Fishkill, a volunteer firefighter and a private pilot.

Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as Correction, Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry, Governmental Operations, Local Governments, and Oversight, Analysis and Investigation.
